sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Freeze the candidate: it uses the canonical namespace, correct ship-to-structural-member targeting, owner-correct paths, required controlled alternatives, support-level conditions, termination applicability, and structural-member evidence placement. Deterministic validation is valid and no vocabulary matching is required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Move frameSupportCondition constraints from MemberSupportShape, FixedMemberSupportShape, and SimpleMemberSupportShape onto the structural member, because its canonical requiredOwner is structuralMember. Keep continuousThroughSupport on the structural member, and constrain connectionBracketPresent, demonstratedRotationalRestraint, and significantRotationalRestraintEvidence on each member-support node. Encode the alternatives across those correctly owned nodes: continuity or a connection bracket or demonstrated significant rotational restraint requires fixedFrameSupport; otherwise simpleFrameSupport is permitted only when the member does not terminate within the ice-strengthened area. Ensure a member that terminates within that area cannot pass through the simple-support branch and must have fixed support.

REVERSAL: The retrieved canonical record declares significantRotationalRestraintEvidence with requiredOwner structuralMember and domain structuralMember, so the earlier instruction to place it on each member-support node is no longer valid. Move the evidence constraint to the structural-member shape and require it only in the demonstrated-restraint fixed branch; remove its constraints from SupportInputShape and DemonstratedRestraintSupportShape. Keep demonstratedRotationalRestraint on memberSupport, and retain the existing fixed/simple/termination alternatives and owner-correct paths.

Freeze the candidate: it uses the canonical namespace, correct ship-to-structural-member targeting, owner-correct paths, required controlled alternatives, support-level conditions, termination applicability, and structural-member evidence placement. Deterministic validation is valid and no vocabulary matching is required.
